items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: He thought, Mr. Murphy -- [INTERVIEWER] This is the American Consul? -- [INTERVIEWEE] The American Consul. His name was Mr. Murphy, a rather well known diplomat. He advised us to stay undercover

ctx.x: knowing the German mentality, with certain people, they had just taken advantage of it, you see.

I had propositions -- that is when the Germans came in I was at the Club Pierre Charon on the Champs Elysee, and the proprietor sent for us to come back after the Germans left. And when I went down to the Consulate, the Consul told me that it would be best to stay undercover.
